# Pauhu Tool Calling

> Tool calling for AI models: your model calls signed, bounded tools that run on your device; the tool plans come from the Pauhu demo backend. Needs a free Pauhu developer key against the Pauhu demo backend; no key, no result.

- [Developer key](https://pauhu.dev/developer-terms/): free, 90 days, 50 requests a day, at most 5 a minute
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for AI agents
- [server.json](server.json): MCP remote server
- [Skill](skills/pauhu-developer-key/SKILL.md)
